scope: Actual bundled pure MovementRules service; strict source/preset/recipe validation, field-domain deterministic randomization and locks, exact four-field preservation, stale/tamper refusal, detached World preflight and single-room structural limit. No browser, hardware or level-solvability acceptance.

results.name: A schema-12 generated single-room source is detached, deeply frozen and independently identified
Canonical source identity ignores object key order and filename but preserves values
Copied, foreign and forged source wrappers are refused
Viewer mode, nonzero mapper and custom assembly refuse without enabling a backend
Invalid schema, non-JSON values and invalid physics fail instead of normalizing silently
Missing/excluded player scene and invalid training target are refused using detached references
Keep is the default and reports no effective change without rewriting any project field
Sprint targets exactly 2, 3 and 4 pixels per tick at the three intensities
High-jump targets 10, 11 and 12 with gravity 1 and preserves unrelated fields
Slow-fall targets maximum fall 4, 2 and 1 with gravity 1
Heavy-fall uses the specified paired gravity and maximum-fall targets
Only the active backend four scalar settings can change, preserving layout, IDs and inactive physics
Equal seed/source/options repeat exact recipe, project and detached validation
Seeded-mix intensities enforce ±1, ±2 and full legal domains over varied seeds
Seeded-mix full intensity reaches each supported endpoint deterministically
Any first-preview lock is refused instead of silently selecting or inventing a value
Four independent locks preserve prior values while unlocked fields use their own new seed domains
All locks retain exact physics across seed, preset and intensity changes with flat replayable origins
Unlocking drops the inherited origin and returns to current preset values
Locked field can override a paired preset and the result explicitly warns about that interaction
Changed original source content makes both recipe replay and previous locks stale
Unknown options, presets, intensity values and malformed locks are refused
Blank, non-string and oversized seeds are refused
Recipe strict top-level fields, method/version and source/runtime identities are checked
Recipe decisions cannot be tampered, omitted, widened or substituted with fractional values
Recipe source hash, result hash and unlocked rule origins cannot be silently altered
Locked decisions regenerate from their saved origins instead of trusting numerical fields
Single-room preview reports structural checks and explicit pending ROM capacity accurately
World backend takes precedence and compiles the final changed physics into its own preflight artifact
Movement preview/replay preserve all live project/history/emulator state
